import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 1000005;
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static final int BASE_NUM = 1000000;

    static long total_n;
    static List<Integer>[] sequence = new ArrayList[10];
    static long total_count = 0;
    static int[] prefix_sum = new int[10];
    static int final_answer = 0;

    static void fill_sequences(int level, int val) {
        sequence[level].add((int)(((++total_count) - val + MOD1) % MOD1));
        prefix_sum[level] += sequence[level].get(sequence[level].size() - 1) % MOD2;
        prefix_sum[level] %= MOD2;
        if (level == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            fill_sequences(level + 1, 10 * val + i);
        }
    }

    static void process(long x) {
        if (x > total_n) return;
        if (x * BASE_NUM + BASE_NUM - 1 <= total_n && x * BASE_NUM * 10 > total_n) {
            long rk = total_count;
            for (int i = 0, step = 1; i <= 6; i++, step *= 10) {
                int delta = (int)(((rk - x * step) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
                int pos = lowerBound(sequence[i], -delta + MOD1);
                long temp = ((1L * delta * sequence[i].size() % MOD2 + prefix_sum[i]) % MOD2
                        - 1L * (sequence[i].size() - pos) * MOD1 % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
                final_answer += temp;
                final_answer %= MOD2;
                total_count += sequence[i].size();
            }
            return;
        }
        final_answer += (((++total_count) - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
        final_answer %= MOD2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            process(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total_n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            sequence[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        fill_sequences(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(sequence[i]);
        }
        total_count = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            process(i);
        }
        System.out.println(final_answer);
    }
}
